rule: Do not divide total public funding by visitor count and label the result efficiency/value-for-money.
Attendance is an output, not a measure of artistic, scholarly, conservation or public value.
Capital grants and capital projects must not be compared directly with annual attendance without period/perimeter adjustment.
Free-admission museums and charged-entry institutions require contextual treatment.
Collections care, research, loans, acquisitions, education and digital use remain distinct outputs.
Strategy targets are compared only with the matching indicator and period.
No cross-institution ranking or score is generated by SIDONIE from these measures.
